summary.headline: Inceptions and Theodore’s Alexandrian Entry
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging whether an inception will be advantageous, slow, changeable, or enduring, based on benefics and malefics, the Moon, horoskopos, sign types, applications, separations, nodes, and aspects to a stationary star. A worked example analyzes the inception when Theodore the Augustal entered Alexandria, listing planetary positions, angles, lunar nodes, the Lot of Fortune, and testimonies from Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and Venus.
